name: Hot and Sour Soup
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical Chinese hot-and-sour soup recipes using ~2.5 cups stock plus add-ins, commonly yielding 4 modest servings.
Egg is added in the instructions (beaten egg stirred in), so Eggs=true even though not in the provided ingredients list.
Vinegar quantity (1.5 cups) appears unusually high relative to 2.5 cups stock and is treated as listed without alteration.
Wheat=true because soy sauce is typically brewed with wheat unless certified gluten-free; cornstarch is gluten-free but does not override soy sauce.
Gluten-free=false due to wheat in soy sauce and lack of any gluten-free certification.
Dairy-free=true: no milk, butter, cheese or other dairy ingredients listed or implied.
Pescatarian=false due to explicit pork ingredient.
Mushrooms, wood ear, tofu, and spring onions treated as plant-based; chicken stock and pork treated as animal-derived per dietary notes.
Hot pepper sauce treated as ambiguous for fish (some contain fermented fish); left null.
No tree nuts, peanuts, shellfish, or milk present.
instructions:
STEP 1 - MAKING THE SOUP
In a wok add chicken broth and wait for it to boil.
Next add salt, sugar, sesame seed oil, white pepper, hot pepper sauce, vinegar and soy sauce and stir for few seconds.
Add Tofu, mushrooms, black wood ear mushrooms to the wok.
To thicken the sauce, whisk together 1 Tablespoon of cornstarch and 2 Tablespoon of water in a bowl and slowly add to your soup until it's the right thickness.
Next add 1 egg slightly beaten with a knife or fork and add it to the soup and stir for 8 seconds
Serve the soup in a bowl and add the bbq pork and sliced green onions on top.

ingredients.name: Mushrooms
ingredients.assumptions: Shiitake or button mushrooms; 1/3 cup chopped mushrooms ≈27g based on typical density of 80-85g per cup.

ingredients.name: Wood Ear Mushrooms
ingredients.assumptions: Dried wood ear mushrooms rehydrated; 1/3 cup sliced ≈10g dry weight equivalent, using standard rehydrated density in Chinese soups.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.assumptions: Silken or firm tofu; 2/3 cup cubed ≈160g (density ~240g per cup).

ingredients.name: Pork
ingredients.assumptions: BBQ/char siu pork; 1/2 cup diced ≈75g using typical cooked pork density ~150g/cup.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.assumptions: Table salt; 1/2 tsp ≈3g; all values zeroed as pure mineral.

ingredients.name: Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: White pepper; 1/4 tsp ≈0.6g rounded to 1g; negligible macros treated as zero.

ingredients.name: Hotsauce

ingredients.name: Vinegar
ingredients.assumptions: Rice vinegar or black vinegar; 1.5 cups ≈360ml/360g (density ~1g/ml); adjusted for typical vinegar composition.

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce

ingredients.name: Water

ingredients.assumptions: Green/spring onions sliced; 1/4 cup ≈25g using typical density ~100g per cup.
